items.name: Truist Financial
items.headline: Q3 GAAP EPS halves on a $1.4B securities loss and RAC loan sale
items.catalyst: Truist reported Q3 diluted EPS of $0.56 versus $1.04 a year earlier, including a $0.90-a-share AFS securities loss, a $0.36-a-share reserve recapture and $0.06 of RAC sale impacts; adjusted EPS was $1.16.
items.thesis: The bank is using the quarter to reposition its securities book and sell RAC loans in one move. Adjusted ROTCE of 14.6% is the figure management wants judged, but the market will want proof that the securities reinvestment lifts net interest income from the 3.00% margin.

items.name: Citizens Financial Group
items.headline: Q3 EPS up 34% as net interest margin widens to 3.18%
items.catalyst: Citizens reported Q3 diluted EPS of $1.41 versus $1.05 and net income of $636 million versus $494 million, on revenue of $2,322 million versus $2,118 million.
items.thesis: Net interest income growth of about 13% with roughly flat sequential expenses is the cleanest operating-leverage story among today's regional reporters. Lower provisions add to it, though the preliminary CET1 ratio of 10.5% is below the 10.7% of a year ago.
items.source_name: Citizens Financial Q3 2026 financial supplement (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99.3)

items.name: Regions Financial
items.headline: Q3 EPS rises 16% as net charge-offs drop to 0.29%
items.catalyst: Regions reported Q3 diluted EPS of $0.71 and adjusted EPS of $0.73, with net charge-offs of $72 million, or 0.29% of average loans, versus $135 million and 0.55% a year earlier.
items.thesis: Credit, not revenue, is driving the earnings gain: total revenue grew about 3% while losses roughly halved. Record capital markets income of $107 million helps diversify fees, but flat deposits keep the balance-sheet growth story modest.
items.correction: Replaced 'the beat' with 'the earnings gain', since the Regions release makes no comparison with analyst estimates.

items.name: M&T Bank
items.headline: Q3 EPS rises to $5.04 on buybacks while net income dips
items.catalyst: M&T reported Q3 diluted EPS of $5.04 versus $4.82, while net income fell to $775 million from $792 million and estimated CET1 fell to 10.16% from 10.99%.
items.thesis: Loan growth of about 5% and lower charge-offs are solid, but the per-share gain comes from a shrinking share count. A narrower 3.65% margin and a lower capital ratio make the next leg harder to fund with buybacks alone.
items.source_name: M&T Bank Q3 2026 results release (M&T investor relations)

items.name: Alcoa
items.headline: Q3 earnings more than double from a year ago; output guidance reaffirmed
items.catalyst: Alcoa reported Q3 net income attributable to Alcoa of $483 million, or $1.81 a diluted share, versus $232 million, or $0.88, a year earlier, on revenue of $3,704 million versus $2,995 million.
items.thesis: Adjusted EPS of $1.82 was below the $2.12 of Q2, and the Q4 outlook flags about $30 million of unfavorable raw-material and maintenance costs in aluminum plus about $30 million from alumina costs. With volumes reaffirmed, aluminum prices remain the main earnings lever.

items.name: J.B. Hunt Transport Services
items.headline: Q3 revenue up 20% but operating income up only 2%
items.catalyst: J.B. Hunt reported Q3 operating revenues of $3.68 billion versus $3.05 billion and diluted EPS of $1.82 versus $1.76, with Dedicated operating income down 22% to $81.7 million.
items.thesis: Intermodal loads rose 8%, so volume is there, but fuel and fuel-tax expense of $260.4 million versus $164.0 million absorbed much of the revenue gain. Pricing has to catch up with costs for margins to recover.

items.name: Interactive Brokers
items.headline: Q3 EPS rises to $0.69 on 19% net interest income growth; dividend raised
items.catalyst: Interactive Brokers reported Q3 diluted EPS of $0.69 versus $0.59 on net revenues of $1.91 billion versus $1.66 billion, and raised its quarterly dividend to $0.15 from $0.0875.
items.thesis: Net interest income of $1.15 billion is nearly double $602 million of commissions, tying earnings to client cash, margin balances and the rate path. Customer accounts up 35% to 5.58 million keep the base compounding, while the 78% pretax margin slipped from 79%.

items.name: First Horizon
items.headline: Swings to a Q3 loss on a $473M charge to sell about $4.5B of mortgages
items.catalyst: First Horizon reported a Q3 net loss available to common shareholders of $94 million, or $0.20 a share, versus EPS of $0.50 a year earlier, after a $473 million pretax loss on about $4.5 billion of consumer mortgages moved to held for sale; adjusted EPS was $0.53 versus $0.51.
items.thesis: The bank says the sale will be accretive to earnings going forward, the same trade-off Truist made today with its securities book. The cost is capital: preliminary CET1 fell to 10.3% from 11.0% a year ago.
items.source_name: First Horizon Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99.1)
